name: Dolliv
description: Dolliv, the Olive Pokémon, and the evolved form of Smoliv. Able to evolve into Arboliva. A Grass and Normal type.
pokedex_entries: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
It basks in the sun to its heart's content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.
